dogecoin.text:
For any $Dog losing hope - does anyone recognise this fractal? This is Doge dumping from 1st Jan 2021 into the 2021 inaugeration. Dropped almost 50%, past the inaugeration until 28th Jan. Sound familiar? 
Doge then pumped around 10000% until its peak in May. 

Yes $Doge had Elon. https://t.co/pecbMUNwhV
